setlist_extra.title: Quality Is About A For The Most Part(Subjective Of Course)

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Women Are Smarter** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the Women Are Smarter into Eyes of the World transition a killer; Reviewer replayed the Women Are Smarter into Eyes of the World pairing repeatedly [9][13]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Jack Straw is melodic but a bit sluggish and listless on the breakout chorus [19]
- **Althea** (1 review): Althea sways nicely during the bridge, rising above its routine reputation [19]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One is called great, though Bobby's vocals carry a lot of distortion [9]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Jerry sounds great on Wharf Rat [9]
- **Never Trust a Woman** (1 review): Never Trust a Woman swaggers nicely; reviewer wonders whether the song was previously labeled with that title [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-09-12.149414.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 146 min [1]
- **gd88-09-12.sbd-matrix.wiley.8477.sbefail.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 141 min; rated 4.56/5 by 18 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this recording big and powerful, conveying the live experience well [20]
- **gd88-09-12.matrix.nawrocki.11265.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 141 min; rated 4.1/5 by 18 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound wonderful and full of energy; Described as one of the sweetest transfers from this period, with great sound; The recording is described as very sharp [12][13][14][17]
- **gd1988-09-12.149279.ultramatrix.healy-pearson.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 146 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer found a free vial of LSD in Roosevelt Park, across from the venue [10]
- Outside, a Deadland gathering had a teepee handing out free food [10]
- Phil was clearly visible before the second set, working on a large joint before Box of Rain began [14]
- On the floor during set two, a very drunk man in front of the reviewer urinated where he stood [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-09-12.149414.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [1]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy, using Schoeps CMC4/MK41 microphones, front of board, to DAT; Transfers and mastering were done by Charlie Miller, with pitch correction settings from Joe B. Jones; Patch source came from Craig Hillwig and Lenny Stubbe; the file set is 16 bit at 44.1 [1]
- **gd88-09-12.sbd-matrix.wiley.8477.sbefail.shnf**: source: (Healy Mix) SBD>DAT>CDR [5]
- **gd88-09-12.matrix.nawrocki.11265.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD/Matrix > MC > DAT > CDR [6]. Also: Reviewer first knew a snippet of the second set from a Dead Hour broadcast, on a cheap analog copy [13]
- **gd1988-09-12.149279.ultramatrix.healy-pearson.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [2]
